title: Whitened norm as an inverse quadratic form
statement: Let $d$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a positive definite real $d\times d$ matrix, and let $z\in\mathbb R^d$. The squared Euclidean norm of $S^{-1/2}z$ equals the quadratic form $z^{\mathsf T}S^{-1}z$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a positive definite real matrix of size $d\times d$
